 Orry's friendship with Sara Ali Khan ends on a bitter note; says 'I will plot revenge' 
 ETimes.in / Updated: Nov 4, 2026, 14:51 IST Save Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 1 / 4 'I will hurt you back': Orry's shocking revenge warning after fallout with Sara Ali Khan
 Some friendships manage to weather every storm over the years, while others explode so spectacularly that neither person involved ever wants to look back. Orhan Awatramani - better known to the entire internet simply as Orry - seems to have hit that absolute point of no return with his former close pal, Bollywood actor Sara Ali Khan.
 The social media personality recently sat down with Neha Dhupia on her podcast and pulled back the curtain on his nasty fallout with Sara, laying out details that have left Bollywood pop-culture observers completely stunned. From feeling deeply betrayed by a long-time confidant to openly admitting that he holds lifelong grudges, Orry held zero punches and made no effort whatsoever to sugarcoat his lingering bitterness.
 For anyone who hasn't been keeping up with the socialite scene, Orry and Sara actually share a pretty deep history. The two reportedly hit it off during their university days abroad and maintained a tight-knit inner circle for nearly a decade. But those glory days of constant party pictures and cozy celebrity hangouts are officially dead and buried.
 by TOI Lifestyle Desk 2 / 4 ​Orry claims Sara Ali Khan vanished when the tables turned
 Looking back at their ten-year bond, Orry explained that he was always the guy stepping up whenever Sara found herself in hot water. He specifically brought up being right by her side down in Goa when she was swept up in a massive media scandal, insisting he stepped in as a protective wall when she desperately needed a solid support system around her.
 However, according to Orry, when his own life hit a rough patch, that loyalty wasn't even remotely reciprocated.
 Orry revealed that when he was going through a particularly dark phase, he didn't even get a basic check-in call from Sara. That total silence cut him far deeper than he expected, especially considering they had been practically inseparable for a decade.
 To make matters worse, Orry opened up about his volatile dynamic with Sara's mother, veteran actor Amrita Singh. He alleged that Amrita chewed him out on multiple occasions—an experience that left him so thoroughly rattled and drained that he ended up severing digital ties with Sara altogether.
 Reflecting on the entire ordeal during the podcast, Orry laid it all out:
 "Her mother scolded me a lot, so I unfollowed her too. You asked me if there are fake friendships. Sara has been like a childhood friend; we were friends from college and 10 years after that. I was there for her through so much; we were in Goa when she landed in a big case, and I stood by her. In life, at one time when she had to be there for me, she disappeared. In that moment, I felt so bad."
 He went on to claim that he never received a single word of apology for how things were handled. Disillusioned by the whole situation, he officially cut all remaining ties with Sara earlier this year, stating he has zero interest in fake-smiling for the cameras or pretending everything is fine between them.
 3 / 4 'I don't wait for karma, I plot my revenge'
 The podcast conversation took an even wilder, unhinged turn when the topic shifted to how Orry handles people who double-cross him.
 If you thought he was the type to take the high road, turn the other cheek, or practice peaceful forgiveness, think again. Orry openly confessed that he harbors massive grudges and actively confronts anyone who dares to cross him.
 He then dropped a genuinely chilling take on getting even, explaining that he rarely reacts in the heat of the moment because he prefers playing the long game.
 In his own words:
 "You will think that if you hurt me today and I do nothing, I don't wait for Karma. I will plot the revenge myself; it might take years to play out, but it will come when you are least expecting it. If you hurt me, I will hurt you back and balance the scales myself. I will attack all my enemies."
 It is a remarkably aggressive stance - and one that has added a whole new layer of drama to his public rift with Sara and her family.
 4 / 4 This isn't the first time he's called out Amrita Singh
 Interestingly enough, this isn't the first time Orry has publicly vented about his traumatizing interactions with Amrita Singh.
 During a previous interview with Pinkvilla, he briefly recounted a specific incident from 2021 that left a massive scar on his mental well-being. He described that entire timeframe as one of the absolute lowest points of his life, admitting the emotional stress nearly broke him completely.
 Orry shared back then that while people in his circle kept telling him to stay strong and push through it, he eventually hit a breaking point where he just kept asking himself why he was being forced to tolerate so much toxicity in the first place.
 He noted that the ordeal fundamentally changed his personality and hardened his stance toward relationships. By the end of it, he had grown so numb that very little could get under his skin anymore. Looking back, he credits those painful experiences with reshaping his entire outlook and teaching him how to navigate the shark-infested waters of public fame.
 As of right now, Orry clearly has zero desire to extend an olive branch or patch things up with his former best friend. And judging by the fire he's breathing, this is one high-society friendship that is going to stay buried for good.
